log.title: Logs

warning.engineLogsMissing: Engine logs were not found, so the package has no Engine evidence. Restart UniClip and export again.
warning.engineLogsUnreadable: Some or all Engine logs were found but couldn't be read, so the package may be incomplete. Restart UniClip and export again.
warning.engineLogsWrittenNotFound: The Engine reports written logs, but the files are missing from disk. The package is incomplete; restart UniClip and export again.
warning.networkLogsIncomplete: Network logs may be incomplete: some files could not be flushed, read or verified. Only this process was flushed; other processes such as the keyboard were not.

log.exportMethodPrompt: Choose whether to share the logs or export them as a file.

capture.title: Detailed diagnostics
capture.description: Start recording before reproducing the issue, then export logs. Details stay on this device for a capture of up to 10 minutes. Earlier activity is not recovered, and other extensions are not enabled automatically.
capture.failed: Could not complete the action. Please try again.
capture.unavailable: Unavailable until the service is ready.

log.exportDescription: Share, or save as a file
log.storageHint: Log files can be cleared under Storage.

power.title: Battery and background activity
power.collecting: Not enough data yet. Use the phone normally and check again later.

battery.title: Whole-phone battery (not this app)
battery.ready: {{change}} % over {{duration}} unplugged, all apps and the screen included
battery.suspect: {{change}} % over {{duration}} unplugged. This phone's charge counter looks unreliable, so only the percentage is shown
battery.collecting: Needs about 10 minutes unplugged to show a change
battery.unavailable: This phone does not report battery readings to apps

power.gap: {{duration}} was not recorded because the app was not running.
power.footer: Android does not tell apps how much battery they use. Battery figures cover the whole phone, and CPU and network figures are this app's own activity, not a measured power cost. Statistics stay on this device and are included when you export logs.
